summary: VS MEDIA Holdings filed a 6-K reporting an October 9, 2026 extraordinary general meeting in Singapore where shareholders approved, by simple majority, a corporate group restructuring. VSM Holdings will transfer all VS MEDIA PTE. LTD. shares to Aurenza Group Limited, then the Company sells all VSM shares to an unaffiliated third party for US$1.00, disposing of loss-making businesses. Approximately 53.60% of entitled votes were represented at the meeting. Shareholders also approved a second amended memorandum and articles, including a name change to Forcendra Holding Limited, share division/combination authority, Class B redemption rights, and a reduced 50% director-removal threshold. Watch disposal completion and any residual liabilities.
